SELECT authority FROM ( SELECT 'ROLE_' || role.code AS authority FROM auth_user_role user_role JOIN auth_role role ON role.id = user_role.role_id WHERE user_role.user_id = #{userId} AND role.deleted = false AND role.enabled = true
UNION
SELECT permission.code AS authority FROM auth_user_role user_role JOIN auth_role role ON role.id = user_role.role_id JOIN auth_role_permission role_permission ON role_permission.role_id = role.id JOIN auth_permission permission ON permission.id = role_permission.permission_id WHERE user_role.user_id = #{userId} AND role.deleted = false AND role.enabled = true AND permission.deleted = false AND permission.enabled = true ) authority_set ORDER BY authority ASC
